text:
nico: Quick thread: planning a 48-hour community code sprint + micro launch. Deliverables: 2 tutorials, 1 tiny refapp repo, a 15-min demo, social assets, and a short benchmark blurb. Who wants which?

rachael: I can own the refapp + README. Will add a CONTRIBUTING.md and quickstart script. Need a single benchmark stat for the hero.

sam: I'll handle webinar logistics and signup CTAs. Suggest Thu 9am PT. Also will wire utm_campaign=code-sprint and set webhook to community SFDC queue.

olga: I'll make hero + 3 tweet cards. Need the single stat by Wed noon. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/code-sprint-assets

perf-bot: Running perf sweep: command used `./bench --model redwood-6b --batch 6 --seq 384`

rachael: Webinar format: 15-min demo + 10-min Q&A. We'll preselect 4 dev-focused questions.

nico: Messaging idea: "Fork the refapp and ship a working LLM feature in under an hour." Use a p95 latency callout.

perf-bot: Initial numbers posted: p95(dedicated)=142ms, p50=78ms, estimated cost per 100k tokens ~$115 (batching on).

olga: Great — I'll lock copy with p95 delta and prep assets by Wed EOD.
sam: I'll add UTM template: `/signup?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=code-sprint` and set webhook example to sandbox.
nico: Perfect. I'll draft the launch post and a short dev thread for X. Drafts due Thur 11am. Thanks! :rocket:
